raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

A batch-wide no-LoRA check cannot skip work when a request uses an adapter but
the current layer has no weights for that adapter. For example, a q_proj/v_proj
adapter still carries a valid LoRA ID through o_proj and MLP layers.

This matters for heterogeneous serving. If resident adapters target q/v,
q/k/v/o, and gate/up/down respectively, the static union covers every module,
but a request using only the q/v adapter has no useful LoRA work in most layers.

This PR:

- tracks which adapter slots are populated for each LoRA layer;
- derives active token and sampler slot sets from the existing CPU mapping;
- bypasses dense, embedding, and logits LoRA work in eager mode when the active
  and populated slot sets are disjoint;
- preserves the existing path under torch.compile and graph modes, without any
  device-to-host synchronization; and
- conservatively keeps a packed wrapper active when any packed slice is
  populated.

MoE and fully-sharded override paths are unchanged.

This does not duplicate #47951, which handles only batches with no active LoRA.
It is also materially different from #48887: that PR's host-level decision uses
the static union of all loaded adapters and explicitly cannot skip a layer when
heterogeneous resident adapters collectively cover all modules. This PR
intersects the current batch's active slots with the current layer's populated
slots.

AI assistance was used for investigation, implementation, testing, and
benchmark analysis. The submitting author reviewed the changes and remains
responsible for them.

## Test Plan

Run the LoRA manager and layer suites:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/lora/test_lora_manager.py \
  tests/lora/test_layers.py
```

Run pre-commit checks for the changed range:

```bash
pre-commit run --from-ref origin/main --to-ref HEAD
```

For end-to-end correctness, compare upstream and candidate Qwen3-8B BF16 TP=2
eager servers with four resident rank-8 adapters targeting q/v, q/k/v/o,
gate/up/down, and all seven linear projections. Use deterministic decoding and
compare generated tokens and per-token logprobs for both selective and broad
adapters.

For performance, use random 32-token inputs, request 128 output tokens with EOS
ignored, concurrency 1, and compare median run-level mean TPOT and output
throughput. Run five 20-prompt repetitions for q/v and three 10-prompt
repetitions for all-linear.

## Test Result

Unit tests on XPU:

```text
202 passed, 144 skipped
```

The focused semantic coverage includes no-LoRA, matching and non-matching
adapters, multi-adapter intersection, slot replacement, embedding, distinct
token and prompt mappings for logits, and graph-disabled behavior.

Reference/candidate Qwen3-8B generation for selective and broad adapters
produced identical 32 output tokens with maximum per-token logprob difference
`0.0`.

Qwen3-8B, BF16, TP=2 on two Intel Arc Pro B70 GPUs, eager mode, concurrency 1,
32 input / 128 output tokens, ignore EOS, deterministic decoding:

| Request | Runs | Baseline TPOT | This PR TPOT | Delta | Baseline output | This PR output |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| q_proj/v_proj | 5 x 20 | 39.471 ms | 30.843 ms | -21.86% | 25.26 tok/s | 32.29 tok/s |
| all seven linear projections | 3 x 10 | 39.511 ms | 39.380 ms | -0.33% | 25.22 tok/s | 25.33 tok/s |

All requests completed with the requested token counts and zero failures.
Ruff, formatting, mypy, SPDX, test-tethering, and the other changed-range
pre-commit hooks passed.

The repository-wide all-files run additionally reached two unrelated
environment-sensitive checks: the current dependency resolver attempted to
refresh the ROCm lockfile, and the container-only non-root entrypoint HOME
assertion failed. A confirming all-files run skipped those two checks and passed
everything else.

---

<details>
<summary>Essential Elements of an Effective PR Description Checklist</summary>

- [x] The purpose of the PR, including related and potentially overlapping PRs.
- [x] The test plan, including test and benchmark commands/configuration.
- [x] The test results, including correctness and before/after performance.
- [x] Documentation update considered; no user-facing documentation change is
  required for this internal eager-mode optimization.

</details>
